section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section describes a single study (Study 1) conducted in the United Arab Emirates that aims to develop and validate an Arabic-translated version of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The study hypothesizes that BAS-2 scores will be positively associated with body image and body pride measures but negatively associated with self-reported BMI. The section emphasizes the importance of this research given the UAE's modernization and exposure to Western media, and notes that no previous studies have investigated body appreciation in Arab populations.
